title: Fundamental Assumptions
description: Essential Criteria: Clearly state the differences in assumptions between MB and FD statistics.

title: Energy Distribution Plots
description: Essential Criteria: Provide accurate rough plots of energy distribution functions for both MB and FD statistics, indicating temperature differences.

title: Specific Heat Explanation
description: Essential Criteria: Explain the discrepancy in specific heat predictions and how FD statistics resolves it.

title: Indistinguishability Principle
description: Important Criteria: Mention the principle of indistinguishability as a key aspect of FD statistics.

title: Pauli's Exclusion Principle
description: Important Criteria: Discuss Pauli's exclusion principle and its significance in FD statistics.

title: Temperature Indication
description: Optional Criteria: Clearly indicate which curve corresponds to the higher temperature in the plots.

title: MB Specific Heat Prediction
description: Pitfall Criteria: Avoid stating that MB statistics accurately predicts specific heat at all temperatures.

title: Neglect of Electron Contribution
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure not to overlook the condition under which electron contribution to specific heat is negligible.
